subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three stale action-pin assertions are repaired, do the security/workflow owners approve executing this grouped set of privileged third-party action revisions on the final exact head?
rationale: Several updated actions receive credentials, write-capable repository access, publishing access, or security artifacts, and the protected security label requires explicit owner judgment that automated checks cannot supply.

options.title: Repair and approve grouped update
options.body: Synchronize the three assertions, rerun exact-head workflow and security checks, and approve the grouped revisions after owner source review.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate app-token, Codex, CodeQL, and container-publishing updates into smaller PRs for independent security review.

options.title: Pause the dependency batch
options.body: Keep the PR open without landing until the security boundary and Dependabot access/rebase instability are resolved.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve grouped update
recommendation.body: Synchronize the three assertions, rerun exact-head workflow and security checks, and approve the grouped revisions after owner source review.
